description: Cypress support file for end-to-end testing in the Superset frontend, including custom commands for dashboard/chart management, login, and UI verification.

methods.name: loadChartFixtures
methods.description: Loads chart fixtures from 'charts.json' into CHART_FIXTURES array.

methods.name: loadDashboardFixtures
methods.description: Loads dashboard fixtures from 'dashboards.json' into DASHBOARD_FIXTURES array.

methods.name: skipLogin
methods.description: Determines if login should be skipped based on current test title.

methods.name: cleanDashboards
methods.description: Deletes dashboards matching fixtures from the database.

methods.name: cleanCharts
methods.description: Deletes charts matching fixtures from the database.

methods.name: getBySel
methods.description: Gets DOM element by data-test attribute.

methods.name: getBySelLike
methods.description: Gets DOM element by partial data-test attribute.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login via POST request and handles redirects.

methods.name: visitChartByName
methods.description: Visits a chart page by its name using API to resolve ID.

methods.name: visitChartById
methods.description: Visits a chart page by its ID.

methods.name: visitChartByParams
methods.description: Visits a chart page by form data parameters, posting to API to get form_data_key.

methods.name: verifySliceContainer
methods.description: Verifies that the slice container and optional chart are visible and have size.

methods.name: verifySliceSuccess
methods.description: Verifies that a slice request was successful and optionally matches query substring.

methods.name: createSampleDashboards
methods.description: Creates sample dashboards from fixtures, optionally by indexes.

methods.name: createSampleCharts
methods.description: Creates sample charts from fixtures, optionally by indexes.

methods.name: deleteDashboardByName
methods.description: Deletes a dashboard by its name.

methods.name: deleteDashboard
methods.description: Deletes a dashboard by its ID.

methods.name: getDashboards
methods.description: Fetches list of dashboards.

methods.name: getDashboard
methods.description: Fetches a specific dashboard by ID.

methods.name: updateDashboard
methods.description: Updates a dashboard by ID with provided body.

methods.name: deleteChart
methods.description: Deletes a chart by ID.

methods.name: getCharts
methods.description: Fetches list of charts.

methods.name: deleteChartByName
methods.description: Deletes a chart by its name.
